about: NRB Bearings have pioneered in the manufacturing of needle roller bearings in India since 1965. More than 90% of the vehicles running on Indian roads are running on bearings manufactured by NRB. The Company is engaged in the business of manufacturing ball and roller bearings having its applications in automotive sector as well as across all mobility applications.
